limitations: Pure row resolver only; caller verifies files against pinned descriptors.
Heritage cong_id semantics remain unqualified; no implicit Bioguide crosswalk.
Unrecognized explicit periods remain unresolved, without release-year fallback.
Senate district literals are retained and explicitly marked not applicable; House at-large context remains restrictive.
Adoption requires rebuilt members with votesmart_id, bioguide_previous_json and other_names_json; no official input was rebuilt or published.
Dated name patches use conservative half-open alias intervals; unqualified or undated aliases cannot establish historical matches.
Typed upstream vote IDs need a qualified chamber vote_date and existing canonical vote_id; incomplete hN-YEAR IDs remain unresolved and no session arithmetic is used.

provider_tests.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync pytest -q tests/test_legislators.py tests/test_table_contracts.py -k 'legislator or members or member_terms'

resolver_type_check.command: uv run --no-sync ty check src/spicy_regs/scorecards/resolution.py tests/test_scorecard_resolution.py
